ticket.title: OpenAPI: path parameter `index` on GET /api/status/{id}/check/{index} is published `required: false` — the only optional path parameter in the spec; Schemathesis 4.27.5 reports it as a Schema Error

repo.test_runner: vitest (run one file with `npx vitest run <file>` from Blockchain/Dev/services/vc-issuer)
repo.typescript: strict, noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters, esModuleInterop, module commonjs, target es2021; the product file's imports at the tip are: import { z, sharedRegistry, commonErrorResponses, FX } from '@secuura/shared'; | import { SecuuraCredentialType, VerificationLevel } from '@secuura/shared/vc';

sites.note: **must change**: `      index: z.coerce.number().int().nonnegative().openapi({ type: 'integer', minimum: 0 }),` - E1 (the one `-` line; re-emitted as a `+` with `, param: { required: true }` added inside the `.openapi({...})` object, under a new KS-1287 comment line)
(correct) `      id: z.string(),` - stays (E1's second leading context line; `id` already renders `required: true`)
(correct) `  responses: {` - stays (E1's last trailing context line)

expected_plus: // KS-1287: coerce parses null as 0, so the lib reads the param as nullable and publishes required: false - pin it.
index: z.coerce.number().int().nonnegative().openapi({ type: 'integer', minimum: 0, param: { required: true } }),
defect_line.sites_rule: every site with must_change=true MUST be changed by the product hunk (its text appears as a '-' line); the checker refuses a diff that leaves one untouched (A3b) before any test runs
red_cells: RED KS-1287 A: the index path parameter renders required: true
RED KS-1287 B: no vc-issuer operation publishes an optional in: path parameter
